developer.dag.footer: Append-only event chain. Every node is signed by your DID's sandbox secp256k1 dev-key. Same identity, new substrate. Replays into state, exports to Nostr.
developer.dag.labSubtitle: Live · append / verify / replay / export / import
developer.identity.footer: Read-only projection: your DID as root, with leaves drawn from the existing cards, contacts, groups, and event stores. No new data - a different angle on the state your DID already owns.
developer.identity.treeSubtitle: Live · DID-rooted projection of cards, contacts, groups, DAG
developer.mode.footerOff: Enable Developer Mode to reveal the DID-first extension playground (P2P, Identity Tree, DAG, Nostr Bridge, Common Friends).
developer.mode.footerOn: DID-first extension playground. Every Lab is something your active DID can already do - but the public surface does not expose. Public surface stays frozen at Swift v1.3.1 parity.
developer.nostr.footer: Projects your DID's sandbox secp256k1 key onto a Nostr event envelope. Any relay carries the DAG. No default relay list - relays come from your input only.
developer.nostr.labSubtitle: Live · publish/subscribe HEAD via NIP-78 kind 30078
developer.p2p.footer: BLE L2CAP signaling → WebRTC LAN data channel. Backend-less. Works offline when both devices share Wi-Fi; BLE-only path works in airplane mode + BT on.
developer.p2p.labSubtitle: Live · DAG three-step sync demo, handshake QR, ICE field
developer.pear.footer: A3.1 proves the react-native-bare-kit worklet runtime links. A3.2 adds the real hyperswarm lane — topic join, Noise relay, frame codec (Pear Lane Lab below).
developer.pear.labSubtitle: Smoke · one-message IPC echo through a Bare worklet
developer.pear.laneLabSubtitle: Live · two worklets, one hyperswarm topic, ping/pong relay
developer.pear.timeoutError: Echo timed out after 10s — worklet terminated.
developer.pearLane.authenticatedSubtitle: Both sides authenticated — sending a test frame…
developer.pearLane.crossDevice.biometric: Face ID was cancelled or denied.
developer.pearLane.crossDevice.echoedSub: Echoed a ping back to the dialer — check its screen for the measured round trip.
developer.pearLane.crossDevice.footer: Both sides must already know each other's DID (paste it — QR scanning isn't wired into this lab yet). The current handshake needs both DIDs known upfront; an anonymous "any responder" mode is a follow-up, not this task.
developer.pearLane.crossDevice.rootKeyNo: No root identity yet — finish onboarding first.
developer.pearLane.crossDevice.warning: Uses your PRODUCTION root identity (Face ID gated when signing the challenge response) — this is the real cross-device PoC, not a sandbox. See docs/ref/notes-pear-poc.md for the two-device runbook.
developer.pearLane.description: Spawns two Bare worklets in this process, each running its own hyperswarm instance, and has them join the same topic over the real DHT, then run the full mutual DID-challenge handshake before exchanging a test frame — proving the RN ↔ worklet ↔ Noise-socket relay pipeline AND the authentication layer on top of it end to end. Needs real network egress (UDP) to reach DHT bootstrap nodes; on a network that blocks it, this times out honestly instead of faking success.
developer.pearLane.discoveringSubtitle: Starting worklets and joining the topic on the DHT (needs network)…
developer.pearLane.frameReceivedSubtitle: Round trip complete in {{ms}}ms — authenticated end to end
developer.pearLane.handshakingSubtitle: Noise connection open — running the mutual DID-challenge handshake…
developer.pearLane.timeoutError: Timed out waiting for DHT join/connect/handshake/round trip — check network (DHT bootstrap needs UDP egress).
developer.pearLane.title: Pear Lane Lab
developer.socialGraph.footer: Common-friend discovery via DAG diff. Replaces the Swift SocialGraphIntersectionService hash-of-name PSI, which leaks ordering and is dictionary-attackable.
